mapping.summary: Rental management: quotes, contracts, scheduling, delivery and return, deposits, sub-rent and invoicing.
claims: Rental quotes and contracts, including additional contracts
Rent classes and rent packages
Rents and schedules items, service items (machines) and resources
Planning boards and availability overviews, including a Rentboard dispatch view
Customer-specific price and discount conditions
Damage handling during delivery and return
Rental deposits are handled
Handles contracts when renting in from a third-party lessor
Graduated prices and percentage rental rates
Extra contract items such as transport and cleaning are charged
Variable revenues such as fuel prices can be billed
Billing by consumption type and wear and tear
Minimum rental periods and rent breaks
Delivery and return protocols with checklists, pictures and signatures
Invoicing runs on invoice plans
Utilisation and profitability analysis
Sub-rent contracts linked to partner requests, with cost and revenue overview
Transport instructions for sub-rent partners
Workflows can be set up for rental processes
Requires a BC Premium licence
